_doc.board: 5 rows × 5 cols = 25 cards, index r*5+c (row-major), dealt from ONE shuffled 52-card deck — all 25 cards unique.
_doc.lines: Exactly 7 paylines: H0–H4 horizontal rows plus long diagonals D0=0,6,12,18,24 and D1=4,8,12,16,20. No verticals, no zigzags, no ways, no clusters.
_doc.winRule: spinWin = Σ over 7 lines of handPay(line) × max(1, Σ cell multipliers on that line), capped at maxWin. Multipliers SUM on the line and multiply the hand pay — they never add to it. Golden cells never carry a multiplier.
_doc.freeSpins: Each line term additionally × max(1, bonusBank). bankAdd is the sum of × that sit on a paying line, added BEFORE this spin's factor. During FS, 3 goldens retrigger +5 extra spins (cap maxFs).
_doc.goldens: Bonus kind is sampled first (flush 1/1500 → 5 goldens, job 1/120 → 4, standard bonus 1/160 → 3, else tease 0–2). During free spins 3 goldens retrigger +5 FS (1/80). At most one golden per column.
_doc.floorPolicy: Conditional deal with capped rerolls. job modes (JOB free spins, SPIN JOB): redeal until ≥1 line is Jacks-or-Better or better (cap floorRerolls.job). flush modes (FLUSH free spins, SPIN FLUSH): redeal until ≥1 line is Flush or better (cap floorRerolls.flush). If a cap is exhausted the last board is accepted as-is.
_doc.linePayScale: 1 — hands.pays ARE the published per-line table (0.25 / 0.5 / 0.75 / 1 / 1.5 / 2 / 8 / 20 / 200), paid as-is. No scale trims: 96% RTP is held by trigger chances (triggers block) and buy/ante prices (bonusBuy/anteSpin priceUiX).
_doc.modeScale: All 1 — displayed wins equal the published paytable in every mode. Never reintroduce part scales; retune prices/triggers instead.
_doc.pricing: priceUiX = ceil(E[part]/0.96, 2dp) is the charged price and must equal game_config.py BetMode.cost. priceX is the fair EV. Base triggers share one λ scale solved from E[spin] + λ·Σ p·E[part] = 0.96.
